mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SELECTION (SELECTION_ID, PARTICIPANT_ID, RESTAURANT_ID) VALUES (#{selectionId}, #{participantId}, #{restaurantId})
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(r.KAKAO_PLACE_ID) AS ID, r.NAME, r.CATEGORY, r.ADDRESS, r.ROAD_ADDRESS, r.PHONE, r.PLACE_URL, r.LAT, r.LNG, 0 AS DISTANCE_METERS FROM SELECTION s JOIN RESTAURANT r ON r.RESTAURANT_ID = s.RESTAURANT_ID WHERE s.PARTICIPANT_ID = #{participantId}
